title: Cyclical Learning Rates for Training Neural Networks
text:
Leslie N. Smith
U.S. Naval Research Laboratory

title: Abstract
text: We propose a new method for setting the learning rate called cyclical learning rates.

title: 1. Introduction
text: Training deep neural networks is time-consuming. Learning rate is critical.

title: 2. Method
text: We use cyclical learning rates that vary between a lower and upper bound.

title: 3. Experiments
text: Experiments on CIFAR-10 and ImageNet show improved performance.

title: 4. Conclusion
text: Our method is simple and effective for training neural networks.
